CMOS latched clock gate
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VCLK clk 0 PULSE(0 3.3 20n 100p 100p 19.9n 40n)
VEN en 0 PWL(0 0 30n 0 30.1n 3.3 70n 3.3 70.1n 0 110n 0 110.1n 3.3 150n 3.3 150.1n 0 190n 0)
XDUT vdd 0 en clk gclk astra_030_cmos_latched_clock_gate
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec blocked_first range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec full_first range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec low_first range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec blocked_second range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec full_second range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec low_second range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 10p 190n
meas tran blocked_first MAX v(gclk) FROM=22n TO=39n
meas tran full_first MIN v(gclk) FROM=62n TO=79n
meas tran low_first MAX v(gclk) FROM=82n TO=99n
meas tran blocked_second MAX v(gclk) FROM=102n TO=119n
meas tran full_second MIN v(gclk) FROM=142n TO=159n
meas tran low_second MAX v(gclk) FROM=162n TO=179n
write out.raw
quit
.endc
.end
